result.summary: Found 1 issue: a loading spinner is stuck over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar photo, obscuring the dish even though the image appears rendered.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner with an opaque white background is overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, even though the ramen photo is clearly rendered behind it. The spinner covers the middle of the dish and looks like a stuck loading state.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator as soon as the image finishes loading, and only display it while the image is actually loading (or replace it with an error/retry state if loading fails).

issues.description: Unselected category chips (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) use gray text on a light gray pill background, giving weak contrast that may be hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the unselected chip label color so it meets WCAG contrast against the pill background.
